title: "Matuto ka kayang makisama"
author: Res
body:
Sorry, okay? Ewan ko ba, hindi ko talaga magawa.

I appreciate naman that they try to include me kahit napaka walang kwenta kong kasama, pero sometimes I wish I could tell them na okay lang, don't mind me nalang. Because whenever pinapansin nila ako, nappressure lang ako to perform, and I never do it well; I only disappoint myself and others. I wish I could enjoy it pero I always end up feeling bad about myself because I could only let others down.

I understand naman na socialization is an important and natural event every time there's a gathering of people, even though pumunta lang ako doon because merong kailangan gawin. It's normal and healthy, yung expectation nila na makisama rin ako. Ako lang talaga yung abnormal.

I feel like wala pa rin akong pinagbago. Akala ko nag iimprove na ko socially, and certainly yes; mas malala ako dati. Pero alam mo yun, it's still not enough.

Gusto ko umiwas nalang, I want them to leave me alone. Ayoko na silang madisappoint. Although alam ko the healthiest way is not to run away but to actually try to socialize, make mistakes, and overcome this shit. I'm wondering here bakit walang nagbabago but the truth is it's because I never try. That's why. Pero I guess masyado lang talaga akong duwag na kahit alam ko na yung solution, I still won't take the step.

Guhhh...

title: Okay
author: Res
body:
Bahala na, wala na 'kong pake.

Alam mo, ito lang talaga problema ko sa buhay eh. I can't just act well socially. Everybody else can do it just fine. Ako, I can't even react properly sa mga nangyayari sa paligid ko. Pag tinanong ako nang any personal question, I freeze up. Like, brother! Napaka NPC mo naman.

And it's a very bad thing. Ito talaga yung pinag aalala ko eh; with poor social skills, paano ako after graduation, in the real world, where I have to deal with real people? It's the key to success, and I was given 20 years to cultivate it and my time is running out and I still don't have it.

Pero after today, I thought bahala na. Wala na 'kong pake alam. Maybe I really don't have it in me. So what? I only make myself miserable pag may pake ako. I only feel bad if I care. What I'm saying is... I won't stress over this na. I'm sure I'll get by. Pero if I don't perform well socially, 'di ko na iisipin. And who cares what others think. Maybe they think I'm a weird loser. Pero I'm tired, wala na 'kong pake.

In short, I'm not gonna stress over my lack of social skills anymore. It's kinda tiring. Whatever happens nalang.

It's kinda liberating... I feel better now.
